description:
Social media management for AI agents.

Schedule and manage social media posts on Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Google Business Profile through the PostPlanify API. Upload images and videos, read post and account analytics, and reply to comments.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
